subject: ACE onramp: Amplify Health — intros + execution map
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@amplifyhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACE onramp: Amplify Health — intros + execution map

Hi Alex — great talking earlier this week. Following up with the initial plan to get Amplify Health enrolled in the AWS ACE co-sell path and to introduce our PDM/PSM partners so we can align timing and requirements. Key asks and next steps below: 

- ACE registration: we'd like to submit the intake this week. Attached is a short checklist (Amplify-ACE-Checklist.pdf) that lists the typical questions AWS expects.
- PDM/PSM intros: looping in Kimberly (PDM) and Marissa (PSM) from our GTM team — they’ll lead the readiness call and define the 30/60/90 mutual action plan.
- Technical fit: please confirm the ideal 45–60 minute window for a quick run-through of your deployment needs (latency targets, data residency, integration points with your auth layer).

Proposed times: Thu 6/12 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 6/13 08:30–09:30 PT. If neither works, send a few alternatives.

Attaching: Amplify-ACE-Checklist.pdf (short intake), rough intake Qs in body below.

Quick intake (high level):
- Target workloads and expected QPS
- Sensitive data types / residency / compliance constraints
- Preferred AWS regions / account admin contact

Thanks — we’ll drive the AWS registration once we have your confirmation.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sales Lead, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@amplifyhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@amplifyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACE onramp: Amplify Health — intros + execution map

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear plan. Thu 6/12 10:00 PT works for our product lead and me.

A couple quick notes:
- We run PHI-adjacent analytics in us-west-2; will need to validate data flows but tentative yes.
- Procurement looped in — they’ll need the standard marketplace pricing and a contact for our security questionnaire.

I attached the contact for our cloud admin (will forward separately with full IAM owner) and flagged procurement to expect the checklist. See you on Thursday.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Director of Product
Amplify Health
alex.rivera@amplifyhealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@amplifyhealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Amplify Health — mutual action plan draft + readiness call

Hi Alex / Soojin — thanks, joining us in a few minutes for the cadence call. I put together a brief mutual action plan (attached: MutualActionPlan-AMP-047.xlsx) that maps the ACE intake -> PDM readiness -> PSM onboarding steps. Highlights below: 

- Week 0: ACE registration submission (we’ll submit after meeting) and share technical questionnaire with your cloud admin.
- Week 1–2: Security questionnaire return and marketplace pricing alignment with Procurement.
- Week 2–4: Pilot deployment window; PSM to run runbook + telemetry checks.
- Week 4+: Production cutover plan and co-sell enablement materials.

Open items for this call:
1) Clarify whether the pilot will need an isolated VPC / dedicated account (you mentioned a preference).
2) Who owns SSO integration — your engineering or infra team?
3) Procurement: what contract vehicle do you prefer (MSA + SOW or AWS Marketplace listing single purchase)?

I’ll take notes in the shared tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/AMP-2025-047 and update action owners in HubSpot after the call. 

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Partner Development Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachment: MutualActionPlan-AMP-047.xlsx (spreadsheet, 6 rows)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@amplifyhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@amplifyhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACE onramp: Amplify Health — intros + execution map

Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today’s call and confirmed items:

- ACE registration: submitted to AWS ACE intake (registration ID AMP-2025-047). AWS asked for the short checklist and a primary AWS account admin — Alex, please send the IAM owner when you have it.
- Procurement: Kimberly will share standard marketplace pricing examples and we can adapt to your preferred contract vehicle; procurement contact, please expect a short pricing worksheet by EOD Mon 6/16.
- Pilot: tentative window targeted for Jun 23–Jul 7. PSM (Marissa) will schedule a kickoff and share runbook templates.

Links / docs:
- Intake & tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/AMP-2025-047
- AWS ACE submission confirmation: https://aws.amazon.com/partners/ace-registration/AMP-2025-047
- DocuSign (SOW draft): https://docusign.com/amp-047-sow-draft (will send formal link once procurement confirms)

Next actions:
- Alex: IAM owner + any additional compliance contacts (by Fri 6/13)
- Procurement: confirm preferred contract vehicle (by Mon 6/16)
- Kimberly/Marissa: finalize MAP and pilot schedule (by Mon 6/16)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’ll keep AWS informed of progress on the ACE intake.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sales Lead, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
